stages.title: Chapter 11 — the words you typed may be rewritten, expanded or split before retrieval sees them.
Chapter 2 — text becomes index terms, and the rules decide which records are eligible at all.
Chapters 3 and 5–8 — one fast pass over the whole collection produces the candidate set.
Chapter 10 — several candidate lists are combined into one.
Chapter 9 — a shortlist is compared again, more carefully than collection scale allowed.
Chapter 15 — what the reader is finally shown, and what can be recorded about it.
